Preferences contain only a validated local UI path/scroll and same verified identity with finite real TTL. Use actual 4/5/6-week cells, density from response quantities and independent status text/symbols. rules.dateAndPermission: All risk and quantities derive from server asOfBusinessDate; selected date is only the delivery bucket. Abort, immediate generation invalidation and verified-session identity prevent stale responses. Current-page protected photos use original route authorization. History reads original instruction/PO approval only on demand. External/duplicate/unapproved return targets rejected. No permissions added.
